reen.Y > 0 then
            width  = math.min(width,  math.floor(screen.X * 0.92))
            height = math.min(height, math.floor(screen.Y * 0.92))
        end

        shownSize = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
        if Main and not isMaximized then
            Main.Size        = shownSize
            normalWindowSize = shownSize
        end
    end

    Window.UpdateWindowSize()
    ScreenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(Window.UpdateWindowSize)

    function Window:SetLibraryVersion(isLarge)
        LibrarySizeMode = isLarge and "Large" or "Small"
        self.LibrarySizeMode = LibrarySizeMode
        self.LibraryHeight = getCurrentLibraryPreset().Height
        SavedConfig.LibrarySizeMode = LibrarySizeMode
        SavedConfig.LibraryHeight = self.LibraryHeight
        SaveConfig()
        Window.UpdateWindowSize()
    end

    Window.LibrarySizeMode = LibrarySizeMode
    Window.LibraryHeight = getCurrentLibraryPreset().Height

    -- Opcional: reutiliza la mecanica de iconos de TestUI_sprite_v7 sin cambiar
    -- la navegacion original por defecto. Solo se activa desde Ajustes.
    local TabIconCarousel = {
        Enabled = false,
        Items = {},
        Offset = 0,
        Velocity = 0,
        ViewW = 0,
        Anim = nil,
        ActiveTab = nil,
        Spin = 0,
        LastOffset = 0,
    }

    local TAB_ICON_SIZE = 42
    local TAB_ICON_GAP = 6
    local TAB_ICON_STEP = TAB_ICON_SIZE + TAB_ICON_GAP
    local TAB_DRAG_THRESHOLD = 7
    local TAB_FRICTION = 4.2
    local TAB_SPIN_GAIN = 0.6
    local TAB_SPIN_MAX = 24
    local TAB_SPIN_DECAY = 9

    local function tabCarouselScale()
        local s = MainScale.Scale
        if type(s) ~= "number" or s < 0.05 then return 1 end
        return s
    end

    local function applyTabCarouselSpin()
        local spin = TabIconCarousel.Spin
        for _, item in ipairs(TabIconCarousel.Items) do
            local rotor = item.Tab and item.Tab.IconLabel
            if rotor then
                rotor.Rotation = spin * (0.6 + 0.8 * (item.Dist or 0))
            end
        end
    end

    local function renderTabCarousel()
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled then return end
        local count = #TabIconCarousel.Items
        local viewW = TabIconCarousel.ViewW
        if count == 0 or viewW <= 0 then return end

        local length = count * TAB_ICON_STEP
        TabIconCarousel.Offset = TabIconCarousel.Offset % length
        local moved = ((TabIconCarousel.Offset - (TabIconCarousel.LastOffset or TabIconCarousel.Offset) + length / 2) % length) - length / 2
        TabIconCarousel.LastOffset = TabIconCarousel.Offset
        TabIconCarousel.Spin = math.clamp(TabIconCarousel.Spin - moved * TAB_SPIN_GAIN, -TAB_SPIN_MAX, TAB_SPIN_MAX)

        for index, item in ipairs(TabIconCarousel.Items) do
            local x = (((index - 1) * TAB_ICON_STEP - TabIconCarousel.Offset + TAB_ICON_SIZE) % length) - TAB_ICON_SIZE
            item.Button.Position = UDim2.new(0, x + TAB_ICON_SIZE / 2, 0.5, 0)
            local d = math.abs((x + TAB_ICON_SIZE / 2) - viewW / 2) / math.max(viewW / 2, 1)
            local edge = math.clamp((d - 0.6) / 0.4, 0, 1)
            item.Scale.Scale = 1 - 0.2 * edge
            item.Dist = math.clamp(d, 0, 1)
        end
        applyTabCarouselSpin()
    end

    local function focusTabCarousel(tab, animate)
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled or TabIconCarousel.ViewW <= 0 then return end
        local index
        for i, item in ipairs(TabIconCarousel.Items) do
            if item.Tab == tab then
                index = i
                break
            end
        end
        if not index then return end

        local length = #TabIconCarousel.Items * TAB_ICON_STEP
        local target = (index - 1) * TAB_ICON_STEP + TAB_ICON_SIZE / 2 - TabIconCarousel.ViewW / 2
        local delta = (target - TabIconCarousel.Offset + length / 2) % length - length / 2
        TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0

        if animate then
            TabIconCarousel.Anim = {
                From = TabIconCarousel.Offset,
                To = TabIconCarousel.Offset + delta,
                T0 = os.clock(),
                Dur = 0.35,
            }
        else
            TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = TabIconCarousel.Offset + delta
            renderTabCarousel()
            TabIconCarousel.Spin = 0
            applyTabCarouselSpin()
        end
    end

    local function relayoutTabCarousel()
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled then return end
        TabIconCarousel.ViewW = TabCarouselViewport.AbsoluteSize.X / tabCarouselScale()
        TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil
        TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
        renderTabCarousel()
        if TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab then
            focusTabCarousel(TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab, false)
        end
    end

    local carouselPress = nil

    local function onTabCarouselPress(input, item)
        local inputType = input.UserInputType
        if inputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        if carouselPress then return end

        TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil
        TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
        carouselPress = {
            Input = input,
            StartX = input.Position.X,
            LastX = input.Position.X,
            LastT = os.clock(),
            Moved = false,
            Item = item,
        }
    end

    function Window._RegisterCarouselTab(tab, button, onSelect)
        for _, existing in ipairs(TabIconCarousel.Items) do
            if existing.Tab == tab then return end
        end

        local item = {
            Tab = tab,
            Button = button,
            Select = onSelect,
            Scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, button),
        }
        table.insert(TabIconCarousel.Items, item)

        button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if TabIconCarousel.Enabled then
                onTabCarouselPress(input, item)
            end
        end)
    end

    function Window._RefreshTabIconLayout()
        local useCarousel = (SavedConfig.TabIconLayout or "Original") == "Carousel"
        TabIconCarousel.Enabled = useCarousel

        if useCarousel then
            if Window.CompactNavigation and Window.SetCompactNavigation then
                Window:SetCompactNavigation(false)
            end
            local navOpenBtn = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactNavigationOpen")
            local navCloseBtn = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactNavigationClose")
            if navOpenBtn then navOpenBtn.Visible = false end
            if navCloseBtn then navCloseBtn.Visible = false end
            ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -48)
            ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            TabList.Visible = false
            TabListArt.Visible = false
            TabListDivider.Visible = false
            TabListDividerGlow.Visible = false
            CatImage.Visible = false
            TabCarousel.Visible = true

            for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do
                if tab.Button and tab.Button.Parent ~= TabCarouselViewport then
                    tab.Button.Parent = TabCarouselViewport
                end
                if tab.Button then
                    tab.Button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TAB_ICON_SIZE, TAB_ICON_SIZE)
                    tab.Button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                    tab.Button.Rotation = 0
                    tab.Button.Text = ""
                    tab.Button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    tab.Button.Position = UDim2.new(0, TAB_ICON_SIZE / 2, 0.5, 0)
                    tab.Button.ZIndex = 18
                    tab.Button.BackgroundTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0
                end
                if tab.IconLabel then
                    local iconSize = math.clamp((tonumber((Theme.IconSizes or {}).Tab) or 24) + 3, 12, 35)
                    tab.IconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize, iconSize)
                    tab.IconLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(iconSize / 2), 0.5, -(iconSize / 2))
                    tab.IconLabel.ZIndex = 19
                    tab.IconLabel.Visible = true
                end
                if tab.NameLabel then
                    tab.NameLabel.Visible = false
                end
                if tab.SpotifyMark then
                    tab.SpotifyMark.Visible = false
                end
            end

            TabIconCarousel.ViewW = TabCarouselViewport.AbsoluteSize.X / tabCarouselScale()
            renderTabCarousel()
            if TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab then
                focusTabCarousel(TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab, false)
            end
        else
            local navOpenBtn = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactNavigationOpen")
            local navCloseBtn = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactNavigationClose")
            if navOpenBtn then navOpenBtn.Visible = not Window.CompactNavigation end
            if navCloseBtn then navCloseBtn.Visible = Window.CompactNavigation == true end
            ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)
            ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 0)
            TabCarousel.Visible = false
            TabList.Visible = true
            TabListArt.Visible = true
            TabListDivider.Visible = false -- v15: sin línea divisoria
            TabListDividerGlow.Visible = false

            for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do
                if tab.Button then
                    tab.Button.Parent = TabList
                    tab.Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
                    tab.Button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
                    tab.Button.Rotation = -3
                    tab.Button.Text = ""
                    tab.Button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    tab.Button.ZIndex = 8
                    tab.Button.BackgroundTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0
                end
                if tab.IconLabel then
                    local iconSize = math.clamp(tonumber((Theme.IconSizes or {}).Tab) or 24, 12, 32)
                    tab.IconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize, iconSize)
                    tab.IconLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, -(iconSize / 2))
                    tab.IconLabel.ZIndex = 9
                    tab.IconLabel.Rotation = 0
                    tab.IconLabel.Visible = true
                end
                if tab.NameLabel then
                    tab.NameLabel.Visible = true
                end
                if tab.SpotifyMark then
                    tab.SpotifyMark.Visible = (tab.NameSpanish == "Spotify")
                end
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(TabIconCarousel.Items) do
                if item.Scale then item.Scale.Scale = 1 end
            end
            resetScrollTop(TabList)
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = 0
            TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
            TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil
            TabIconCarousel.Spin = 0
            applyTabCarouselSpin()
        end
    end

    function Window:SetTabIconLayout(layout)
        local mode = layout == "Carousel" and "Carousel" or "Original"
        SavedConfig.TabIconLayout = mode
        self.TabIconLayout = mode
        SaveConfig()
        self._RefreshTabIconLayout()
    end

    TabCarouselViewport:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(relayoutTabCarousel)

    track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled or not carouselPress then return end

        local pressType = carouselPress.Input.UserInputType
        local inputType = input.UserInputType
        local matches = (inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and pressType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
            or (inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and pressType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
        if not matches then return end

        local x = input.Position.X
        local dxScreen = x - carouselPress.LastX
        if not carouselPress.Moved and math.abs(x - carouselPress.StartX) > TAB_DRAG_THRESHOLD * tabCarouselScale() then
            carouselPress.Moved = true
        end

        if carouselPress.Moved then
            local now = os.clock()
            local dt = math.max(now - carouselPress.LastT, 1 / 240)
            local dx = dxScreen / tabCarouselScale()
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = TabIconCarousel.Offset - dx
            TabIconCarousel.Velocity = TabIconCarousel.Velocity * 0.5 + (-dx / dt) * 0.5
            carouselPress.LastT = now
            renderTabCarousel()
        end
        carouselPress.LastX = x
    end))

    track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled or not carouselPress then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= carouselPress.Input.UserInputType then return end

        local finished = carouselPress
        carouselPress = nil

        if finished.Moved then
            if os.clock() - finished.LastT > 0.08 then
                TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
            end
        elseif finished.Item and finished.Item.Select then
            finished.Item.Select()
        end
    end))

    track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled then return end

        if TabIconCarousel.Spin ~= 0 then
            TabIconCarousel.Spin = TabIconCarousel.Spin * math.exp(-TAB_SPIN_DECAY * dt)
            if math.abs(TabIconCarousel.Spin) < 0.05 then TabIconCarousel.Spin = 0 end
            applyTabCarouselSpin()
        end

        if carouselPress and carouselPress.Moved then return end

        local anim = TabIconCarousel.Anim
        if anim then
            local t = math.min((os.clock() - anim.T0) / anim.Dur, 1)
            local eased = 1 - (1 - t) ^ 3
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = anim.From + (anim.To - anim.From) * eased
            if t >= 1 then TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil end
            renderTabCarousel()
        elseif math.abs(TabIconCarousel.Velocity) > 8 then
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = TabIconCarousel.Offset + TabIconCarousel.Velocity * dt
            TabIconCarousel.Velocity = TabIconCarousel.Velocity * math.exp(-TAB_FRICTION * dt)
            renderTabCarousel()
        elseif TabIconCarousel.Velocity ~= 0 then
            TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
        end
    end))

    function Window:CreateTab(nameSpanish, nameEnglishOrIcon, iconAsset)
        local nameEnglish = nameSpanish
        if nameEnglishOrIcon and string.find(nameEnglishOrIcon, "rbxassetid") then
            iconAsset = nameEnglishOrIcon
            nameEnglish = nameSpanish
        elseif nameEnglishOrIcon then
            nameEnglish = nameEnglishOrIcon
        end
        
        local displayName = GetText(nameSpanish, nameEnglish)

        local defaultIconAsset = iconAsset
        local themedTabIcons = ThemeTabIcons[Theme.ThemeName]
        if themedTabIcons then
            iconAsset = themedTabIcons[nameEnglish] or themedTabIcons[nameSpanish] or iconAsset
        end
        
        local TabButton = mk("TextButton", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 15,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            ClipsDescendants = false,
            Rotation = -3,
            ZIndex = 8
        }, TabList)
        TabButton:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        TabButton.BackgroundTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0
        corner(TabButton, 6)

        local textStart = 38
        local TabIconLabel = nil
        local SpotifyMark = nil
        if iconAsset then
            local iconSize = math.clamp(tonumber((Theme.IconSizes or {}).Tab) or 24, 12, 32)
            local iconPos = 7
            TabIconLabel = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = TabButton,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, iconSize, 0, iconSize),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, iconPos, 0.5, -(iconSize / 2)),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = iconAsset,
                ImageColor3 = Theme.TabIcon or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 9
            })
            YinIcons.applyTab(TabIconLabel, nameEnglish, nameSpanish)
            textStart = 14 + iconSize
        end

        if nameSpanish == "Spotify" then
            SpotifyMark = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = TabButton,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 10),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, textStart, 0, 18),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = "rbxassetid://74630849553567",
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 9
            })
        end

        local TabNameLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = TabButton,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -(textStart + 10), 1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, textStart, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = displayName,
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 15,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            ClipsDescendants = false,
            ZIndex = 9
        })
        TabNameLabel:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", nameSpanish)
        TabNameLabel:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", nameEnglish)
        -- mismo efecto que la rueda: el texto se oscurece desde la mitad. El degradé multiplica el color del texto
        -- (blanco = sin cambio), así sigue funcionando con cualquier tema, pestaña activa o efecto de texto.
        mk("UIGradient", {
            Name = "YYHalfShade",
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0.45, 0.45, 0.45)),
            }),
        }, TabNameLabel)

        resetScrollTop(TabList)

        local TabPage = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ScrollBarThickness = 2,
            ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never,
            CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 8,
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        }, ContentArea)
        mk("UIListLayout", {
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
        }, TabPage)

        local function clampTabScroll()
            task.defer(function()
                if not TabPage.Parent then return end
                local maxY = math.max(0, TabPage.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - TabPage.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
                if TabPage.CanvasPosition.Y > maxY then
                    TabPage.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(TabPage.CanvasPosition.X, maxY)
                end
            end)
        end
        TabPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteCanvasSize"):Connect(clampTabScroll)
        TabPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"):Connect(clampTabScroll)

        local Tab = {Button = TabButton, Page = TabPage, NameSpanish = nameSpanish, NameEnglish = nameEnglish, IconAsset = iconAsset, IconLabel = TabIconLabel, DefaultIconAsset = defaultIconAsset, NameLabel = TabNameLabel, SpotifyMark = SpotifyMark}

        Tab._ContentParent = TabPage

        -- Rueda de opciones ("curve ui"): manteniendo 1 s un toggle flotante se abren, en círculo y girando
        -- despacio, los toggles de la misma sección de la pestaña. Tocar una opción la prende/apaga.
        if not Window._OpenRadial then
            function Window._OpenRadial(anchor, holder)
                if Window._RadialOpen then return end
                local tab, top
                for _, t in pairs(Window.Tabs or {}) do
                    local page = t.Page
                    local parked = t._Segments and t._Segments.Parked
                    local cur = holder
                    while cur and cur.Parent and cur.Parent ~= page and cur.Parent ~= parked do cur = cur.Parent end
                    if cur and cur.Parent and (cur.Parent == page or cur.Parent == parked) then tab, top = t, cur break end
                end
                if not tab then return end
                local seg = tab._Segments
                local function segOf(child)
                    if not seg then return true end
                    local ok, id = pcall(seg.Assign, child)
                    return ok and id or nil
                end
                local mySeg = segOf(top)
                local options = {}
                local fns = Window._ToggleFns or {}
                for h, fn in pairs(fns) do
                    if h ~= holder and h.Parent then
                        local c = h
                        local page, parked = tab.Page, seg and seg.Parked
                        while c and c.Parent and c.Parent ~= page and c.Parent ~= parked do c = c.Parent end
                        if c and c.Parent and (c.Parent == page or c.Parent == parked) and segOf(c) == mySeg then
                            options[#options + 1] = { fn = fn, order = c.LayoutOrder }
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #options == 0 then return end
                table.sort(options, function(a, b) return a.order < b.order end)
                while #options > 16 do table.remove(options) end

                Window._RadialOpen = true
                local gui = Window.ScreenGui
                local view = gui.AbsoluteSize
                local overlay = mk("TextButton", {
                    Name = "YYRadial", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "",
                    AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 2000,
                }, gui)
                -- v2: el centro es el del toggle (posición relativa a la capa: corrige el margen de la barra de Roblox)
                -- y el tamaño crece con la cantidad de opciones para que no se pisen
                local count = #options
                -- v3: más compacta (crece poco con la cantidad) y entera dentro de la pantalla: si el toggle está
                -- cerca de un borde, el centro se corre lo justo para que ninguna opción quede afuera
                local Ry = math.clamp(58 + count * 5.5, 85, math.max(85, math.min(140, view.Y / 2 - 30)))
                local Rx = math.clamp(Ry * 1.5, 125, math.max(125, math.min(240, view.X / 2 - 90)))
                local textSize = count > 12 and 11 or 12
                local ap, as, op = anchor.AbsolutePosition, anchor.AbsoluteSize, overlay.AbsolutePosition
                -- v4: la rueda se abre en el centro de la pantalla y el toggle viaja hasta ahí; al cerrar vuelve a su lugar
                local cx, cy = view.X / 2, view.Y / 2
                local savedPos = anchor.Position
                local moveDelta = Vector2.new(cx, cy) - Vector2.new(ap.X + as.X / 2 - op.X, ap.Y + as.Y / 2 - op.Y)
                local orbit = mk("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2001,
                }, overlay)
                corner(orbit, 999)
                local orbitStroke = stroke(orbit, Theme.Stroke, 1, 1)
                local dot = mk("TextButton", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 2003,
                }, overlay)
                local pills = {}
                local function shade(c, f) return c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), f) end
                local function paint(p)
                    local on = p.fn.Get()
                    local bg = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.Background
                    local tc = on and (Theme.AccentText or getContrastColor(Theme.Accent)) or Theme.Text
                    p.btn.BackgroundColor3 = bg
                    p.label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    -- el texto se oscurece desde la mitad hacia la derecha
                    p.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, tc),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, tc),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, shade(tc, 0.55)),
                    })
                    p.stroke.Color = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke
                    p.baseStroke = on and 0.1 or 0.45
                end
                -- aviso al prender/apagar: tarjeta abajo al centro con punto de estado, nombre y "Activado/Desactivado"
                local toast
                local function showToast(name, on)
                    if toast then toast:Destroy() end
                    local accent = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.TextDim
                    toast = mk("Frame", {
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 10), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 46),
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        ZIndex = 2006,
                    }, overlay)
                    corner(toast, 14)
                    local ts = stroke(toast, accent, 1.5, 1)
                    mk("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 14), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 18) }, toast)
                    mk("UIListLayout", {
                        FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                        Padding = UDim.new(0, 10), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                    }, toast)
                    local badge = mk("Frame", {
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 2007,
                    }, toast)
                    corner(badge, 999)
                    local mark = mk("TextLabel", {
                        Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = on and "✓" or "–",
                        TextColor3 = on and (Theme.AccentText or getContrastColor(Theme.Accent)) or Theme.Background,
                        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 13, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2008,
                    }, badge)
                    local texts = mk("Frame", {
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = 2007,
                    }, toast)
                    local title = mk("TextLabel", {
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = name, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2008,
                    }, texts)
                    local sub = mk("TextLabel", {
                        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 14), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = on and GetText("Activado", "Enabled") or GetText("Desactivado", "Disabled"),
                        TextColor3 = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.TextDim, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 11,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2008,
                    }, texts)
                    local mine = toast
                    -- entra subiendo y se va bajando (animación propia, sin tweens)
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local t0 = os.clock()
                        while mine.Parent do
                            local t = os.clock() - t0
                            local a = t < 0.25 and t / 0.25 or (t > 1.5 and math.max(0, 1 - (t - 1.5) / 0.25) or 1)
                            local e = 1 - (1 - a) ^ 3
                            mine.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 10 - 34 * e)
                            mine.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.95 * e
                            ts.Transparency = 1 - 0.8 * e
                            badge.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - e
                            mark.TextTransparency = 1 - e
                            title.TextTransparency = 1 - e
                            sub.TextTransparency = 1 - e
                            if t > 1.75 then mine:Destroy() break end
                            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                        end
                    end)
                end
                for i, o in ipairs(options) do
                    local btn = mk("TextButton", {
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 25),
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, Text = "",
                        AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2004,
                    }, overlay)
                    mk("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12) }, btn)
                    corner(btn, 999)
                    -- el texto va en su propia etiqueta para que el degradé oscurezca solo las letras
                    local label = mk("TextLabel", {
                        Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = o.fn.Name(), TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = textSize,
                        TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2005,
                    }, btn)
                    local grad = mk("UIGradient", {}, label)
                    local st = stroke(btn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 1)
                    local scale = mk("UIScale", { Scale = 0.3 }, btn)
                    local p = { fn = o.fn, btn = btn, label = label, grad = grad, stroke = st, scale = scale, i = i }
                    pills[#pills + 1] = p
                    paint(p)
                    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        if p.dragged then return end
                        p.fn.Flip()
                        paint(p)
                        showToast(p.fn.Name(), p.fn.Get())
                    end)
                end

                local k, target, rot = 0, 1, 0
                local drag = nil
                local lastMovedAt = 0
                local closing = false
                local conn
                local function close()
                    if closing then return end
                    closing, target = true, 0
                end
                dot.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)
                overlay.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if (drag and drag.moved) or os.clock() - lastMovedAt < 0.3 then return end
                    close()
                end)
                local inputs = {}
                inputs[#inputs + 1] = overlay.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        drag = { a = math.atan2(input.Position.Y - cy, input.Position.X - cx), r0 = rot, moved = false, input = input }
                    end
                end)
                inputs[#inputs + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if not drag then return end
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input == drag.input then
                        local a = math.atan2(input.Position.Y - cy, input.Position.X - cx)
                        if math.abs(a - drag.a) > 0.05 then drag.moved = true end
                        rot = drag.r0 + (a - drag.a)
                    end
                end)
                inputs[#inputs + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if drag and (input == drag.input or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                        local moved = drag.moved
                        if moved then lastMovedAt = os.clock() end
                        for _, p in ipairs(pills) do p.dragged = moved end
                        task.defer(function()
                            drag = nil
                            for _, p in ipairs(pills) do p.dragged = false end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
                local n = #pills
                conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                    dt = math.min(dt, 0.05)
                    k = k + (target - k) * math.min(dt * 7, 1)
                    if not drag then rot = rot + dt * 0.18 end
                    local e = 1 - (1 - math.clamp(k, 0, 1)) ^ 3
                    orbit.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 * Rx * e, 2 * Ry * e)
                    if anchor.Parent then anchor.Position = savedPos + UDim2.fromOffset(moveDelta.X * e, moveDelta.Y * e) end
                    orbitStroke.Transparency = 1 - 0.55 * e
                    dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40)
                    for _, p in ipairs(pills) do
                        local s = math.clamp(k * 1.25 - (p.i - 1) * 0.025, 0, 1)
                        local ee = 1 - (1 - s) ^ 3
                        local a = (p.i - 1) / n * math.pi * 2 + rot - math.pi / 2 + (1 - ee) * 1.8
                        p.btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + math.cos(a) * Rx * ee, cy + math.sin(a) * Ry * ee)
                        p.scale.Scale = 0.3 + 0.7 * ee
                        p.label.TextTransparency = 1 - ee
                        p.btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - ee * 0.92
                        p.stroke.Transparency = 1 - ee * (1 - (p.baseStroke or 0.45))
                    end
                    if closing and k < 0.03 then
                        if anchor.Parent then anchor.Position = savedPos end
                        conn:Disconnect()
                        for _, c in ipairs(inputs) do c:Disconnect() end
                        overlay:Destroy()
                        Window._RadialOpen = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        function Tab:CreateContentContainer(name)
            local container = mk("Frame", {
                Name = name or "ContentContainer",
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 8,
            }, TabPage)
            mk("UIListLayout", {
                Parent = container,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
            })
            return container
        end

        function Tab:SetContentContainer(container)
            self._ContentParent = container or TabPage
            return self._ContentParent
        end

        function Tab:GetContentContainer()
            return self._ContentParent or TabPage
        end

        function Tab:ResetContentContainer()
            self._ContentParent = TabPage
            return TabPage
        end

        -- Selector de secciones al inicio de la pestaña (tipo "Chat | Work").
        -- segments = { {Id = "mov", Es = "Movimiento", En = "Movement"}, ... }
        -- assign(child) -> Id de la sección de ese elemento, o nil para que se vea siempre.
        -- Lo que no es de la sección elegida se aparta (sin padre), no se destruye: conserva estado y conexiones.
        function Tab:CreateSegments(segments, assign)
            segments = segments or {}
            assign = assign or function() return nil end
            local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
            local parked = Instance.new("Folder")
            parked.Name = "YYSegmentParking"
            local Bar = mk("Frame", {
                Name = "YYSegments",
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.55,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                LayoutOrder = -1000000000,
                ZIndex = 9,
            }, TabPage)
            Bar:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(Bar, 22)
            stroke(Bar, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.55)
            local Scroll = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ScrollBarThickness = 0,
                ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
                AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
                ZIndex = 9,
            }, Bar)
            mk("UIListLayout", {
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            }, Scroll)

            local buttons, selected, applying = {}, nil, false
            local count = #segments
            local function apply()
                if not selected or applying then return end
                applying = true
                local pool = {}
                for _, ch in ipairs(TabPage:GetChildren()) do pool[#pool + 1] = ch end
                for _, ch in ipairs(parked:GetChildren()) do pool[#pool + 1] = ch end
                for _, ch in ipairs(pool) do
                    if ch ~= Bar and ch:IsA("GuiObject") then
                        local ok, id = pcall(assign, ch)
                        local show = (not ok) or id == nil or id == selected
                        local target = show and TabPage or parked
                        if ch.Parent ~= target then ch.Parent = target end
                    end
                end
                applying = false
            end
            local function paint()
                for id, b in pairs(buttons) do
                    local on = id == selected
                    TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.05 or 1, TextTransparency = on and 0 or 0.4 }):Play()
                end
            end
            local function choose(id)
                selected = id
                paint()
                apply()
                TabPage.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            end
            for i, seg in ipairs(segments) do
                local fits = count > 0 and count <= 4
                local b = mk("TextButton", {
                    Name = "Seg_" .. tostring(seg.Id),
                    LayoutOrder = i,
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    Size = fits and UDim2.new(1 / count, -4 + 4 / count, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 104, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Text = GetText(seg.Es or tostring(seg.Id), seg.En or seg.Es or tostring(seg.Id)),
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    TextTransparency = 0.4,
                    TextScaled = true,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                    ZIndex = 10,
                }, Scroll)
                b:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
                b:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
                if seg.Es then b:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", seg.Es) end
                if seg.En then b:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", seg.En) end
                mk("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = 14, MinTextSize = 9 }, b)
                mk("UIPadding", {
                    PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8),
                    PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 7), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 7),
                }, b)
                corner(b, 18)
                stroke(b, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.75)
                buttons[seg.Id] = b
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() choose(seg.Id) end)
            end
            -- lo que se agregue después a la pestaña también se ordena por sección
            TabPage.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
                if selected and not applying and ch ~= Bar then task.defer(apply) end
            end)
            self._Segments = { Assign = assign, Parked = parked, Bar = Bar }
            if segments[1] then choose(segments[1].Id) end
            return {
                Select = choose,
                Refresh = apply,
                GetSelected = function() return selected end,
                Bar = Bar,
            }
        end

        local function Select()
            TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab = Tab
            for _, t in pairs(Window.Tabs) do
                t.Page.Visible = false
                t.Button.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
                t.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background
                t.Button.BackgroundTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0
            end
            TabButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            TabPage.Visible = true
            TabPage.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            task.defer(function()
                if TabPage and TabPage.Parent then
                    TabPage.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
                end
            end)
            TabButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            TabButton.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TabActive
            if Window._RefreshCompactNavigation then Window._RefreshCompactNavigation() end
        end

        TabButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled then
                Select()
            end
        end)

        TabButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            local isActive = (TabPage.Visible)
            if not isActive then
                TweenService:Create(TabButton, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {BackgroundTransparency = 0.30}):Play()
            end
        end)
        TabButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            local isActive = (TabPage.Visible)
            if not isActive then
                TweenService:Create(TabButton, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {BackgroundTransparency = (Window._SpotifyAmbient and Window._SpotifyAmbient.Active) and 1 or (Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0)}):Play()
            end
        end)
        TabButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local isActive = (TabPage.Visible)
                if not isActive then
                    TweenService:Create(TabButton, TweenInfo.new(0.10, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        {BackgroundTransparency = 0.35}):Play()
                end
            end
        end)
        TabButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local isActive = (TabPage.Visible)
                if not isActive then
                    TweenService:Create(TabButton, TweenInfo.new(0.20, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        {BackgroundTransparency = (Window._SpotifyAmbient and Window._SpotifyAmbient.Active) and 1 or (Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0)}):Play()
                end
            end
        end)

        table.insert(Window.Tabs, Tab)
        Tab.Select = Select
        if Window._RegisterCompactTab then Window._RegisterCompactTab(Tab) end
        Window._RegisterCarouselTab(Tab, TabButton, Select)
        if #Window.Tabs == 1 then Select() end
        if SavedConfig.TabIconLayout == "Carousel" then
            Window._RefreshTabIconLayout()
